2026-08-08T15:41:51.4883425Z   '{discussion_number: ($discussion_number|tonumber), body: .}' \
2026-08-08T15:41:51.4884585Z   discussion-body.md \
2026-08-08T15:41:51.4885222Z   | safeoutputs update_discussion .
2026-08-08T15:41:51.4885905Z ```
2026-08-08T15:41:51.4888076Z `jq -Rs` reads the file as a raw string (`-R`) and slurps it into a single JSON string value (`-s`), so `body` is always a valid JSON field. Piping `cat file | safeoutputs ...` does not populate `body` and will be rejected.
